title: Color-based genre signals in movie posters: code, data and results
description: Analysis pipeline, derived feature data and complete result tables and figures for the study "The Syntax of Cinema Posters: Machine Learning Insights into Color-Based Genre Expectations". Fifteen interpretable color features (HSV and CIELAB) are extracted from the 25,958 posters of the MM-IMDb dataset and related to all IMDb genre labels with permutation tests, color-only classifiers and class-specific SHAP values, under five alternative genre definitions.
